title: Network initiated detach procedure completion by the UE

entities.name: Network initiated detach procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the network initiates detach and the UE completes it by responding to DETACH REQUEST message and performing various actions based on detach type and EMM cause.

entities.name: DETACH REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by network to initiate detach procedure. Contains detach type and optional EMM cause IE.

entities.name: DETACH ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by UE to acknowledge detach request from network.

entities.name: Detach type
entities.description: IE indicating the type of detach: re-attach required, re-attach not required, or IMSI detach.

entities.name: EMM cause
entities.description: IE providing reason for detach with various cause values like #2, #6, #7, #8, #11, #12, #13, #14, #15, #25, #78.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state entered by UE after detach procedure completion.

entities.name: T3346
entities.description: Timer stopped by UE when receiving DETACH REQUEST with re-attach required.

entities.name: T3396
entities.description: ESM back-off timer stopped by UE when receiving DETACH REQUEST with re-attach required.

entities.name: Detach type indicates re-attach required
entities.description: Condition where UE must deactivate EPS bearers, stop timers, send DETACH ACCEPT, and initiate re-attach.

entities.name: Detach type indicates IMSI detach
entities.description: Condition where UE does not deactivate EPS bearers but sets MM update status and may perform combined TA/LA updating.

entities.name: EPS bearer context deactivation
entities.description: UE locally deactivates EPS bearer contexts including default bearer without peer-to-peer signaling.

entities.name: Transition to EMM-DEREGISTERED state
entities.description: UE enters EMM-DEREGISTERED state after sending DETACH ACCEPT message.

relations.description: Procedure involves receiving DETACH REQUEST message from network.
Procedure involves sending DETACH ACCEPT message to network.
DETACH REQUEST message contains Detach type IE.
DETACH REQUEST message may contain EMM cause IE.
When detach type indicates re-attach required, UE deactivates EPS bearer contexts.
When detach type indicates re-attach required, UE stops timer T3346 if running.
When detach type indicates re-attach required, UE stops timer T3396 if running.
When detach type indicates re-attach required, UE enters EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
When detach type indicates IMSI detach, UE may send DETACH ACCEPT and enter EMM-DEREGISTERED.
Detach type IE value determines if re-attach required condition applies.
Detach type IE value determines if IMSI detach condition applies.
EMM cause IE values determine specific state transitions and behaviors during detach.
